summary: Full-stack regression + new-feature testing of Sri Balanjaneya Swamy Temple (Rampura) site after redesign. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass (health, event registration valid/422 missing/422 invalid-phone, registrations list + event_id filter, contact valid/422 invalid email). Frontend: all 8 routes load (/, /rampura, /temple, /hayagreeva, /mantra NEW, /gallery, /events, /visit). Home hero shows 'Sri Balanjaneya / Swamy · Rampura' with 'JAI SRI RAM' label, Kannada subtitle, two CTAs (hero-temple-cta, hero-events-cta). All 7 home sections render (home-stotra, home-puranic, home-two-idols, home-cardinal, home-blessings, home-shrine-banner, home-visit-teaser). StotraStrip marquee renders site-wide with Kannada Hanuman stotra (uses class .marquee-track — no data-testid). /mantra renders Sanskrit gematria (2 × 5 × 2 × 5 × 2 × 5 = 1,000) and Sankalpa/Stupa content. Header brand uses Hanuman Tilak (data-testid='brand-link' has child img). Temple page has temple-two-idols, Narthaki narrative, and arch-rekha-deula / arch-hoysala-pillars / arch-hayagreeva-scripts cards. RSVP form (rsvp-name-input → rsvp-submit-btn) submits → rsvp-success + toast. Contact form (/visit) submits → contact-success. Gallery lightbox opens on gallery-item-0. Mobile menu lists all 8 nav links including 'Rama Mantra'.

ui_bugs.issue: Review-request specifies a '6-tile blessings band' on /temple, but the page renders no blessings tiles and contains no 'blessings'/'ಆಶೀರ್ವಾದ' text. The blessings band exists only on Home (data-testid='home-blessings'). Likely E1 miss; either remove from spec or add a <BlessingsBand/> section on Temple page.

issues: Hero descriptive paragraph (the lead text under the big italic headline like 'Swamy · Rampura' / 'unfolding.' / 'Rama.') is rendered in a very light cream-on-dark with extremely low opacity — nearly invisible at normal viewing distance. Increase opacity / lighten further for WCAG AA contrast.

Footer text on dark brown background is extremely faint — 'PAGES' link list, address block, hours line, copyright row all sit far below AA contrast. Increase text color from current near-brown to a lighter cream/gold.
Brand mark renders as 'Sri Balanjaneya Swamy — Rampura' (em dash). Review request quoted '· Rampura' (middle dot). Cosmetic only.

action_items: Decide on Temple-page blessings band: either add the 6-tile blessings section to /temple to match the review spec, or update the spec/docs.
Improve text contrast on hero subtitle paragraphs across pages and on the entire footer (currently below AA).
(Optional) Add data-testid='stotra-strip' to the StotraStrip marquee root for easier automation.
(Optional) Switch header brand separator from em dash to middle dot ('·') to match spec verbatim.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py unchanged from iter-1 — root message still says 'Sri Anjaneya Swamy Temple, Rampura' (now stale; renamed to 'Sri Balanjaneya Swamy Temple'). Update the message in @api_router.get('/') and the FastAPI title.
Backend still stores created_at as ISO string in Mongo and reparses on read; not breaking but inconsistent — prefer native BSON datetime.
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject this combo. Set CORS_ORIGINS explicitly for production.
POST /api/events/register and /api/contact return 200 instead of 201 for resource creation (convention nit, non-blocking).
Frontend StotraStrip marquee lacks a data-testid; minor testability gap.
Home hero copy and footer use opacity/utility colors that fall below AA contrast — accessibility risk.
seed_data_creation: Re-used TEST_-prefixed registrations + contact rows created by pytest and the Playwright RSVP/Contact flow. Safe to leave or purge.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py (8 tests, all green). REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://cauvery-heritage.preview.emergentagent.com. Frontend testids verified: brand-link, mobile-menu-toggle, nav-{home|rampura|the-temple|vidya-hayagreeva|rama-mantra|gallery|events|visit}, page-{home/temple/rampura/hayagreeva/mantra/gallery/events/visit}, home-{hero,stotra,puranic,two-idols,cardinal,blessings,shrine-banner,visit-teaser}, temple-{two-idols,architecture,shrine-link}, arch-{rekha-deula,hoysala-pillars,hayagreeva-scripts}, rsvp-{name-input,phone-input,email-input,attendees-input,event-select,message-input,submit-btn,form,success}, contact-{form,name-input,email-input,subject-input,message-input,submit-btn,success}, gallery-item-0..N + gallery-lightbox, header-directions-btn, footer-map-link, footer-link-*.
